_comment: Settings for tools/dev/release_check.py (maintainer pre-release gate). Keys starting with _ are ignored. Regexes are Python syntax.
_method_decision_fixtures: [template, baseline] pairs for check 2. Refresh a baseline on purpose with --update-fixtures, then review the diff.
_dash_chars: check 3 counts these in added lines: em dash, horizontal bar, two- and three-em dash. The en dash (ranges like 2-4) is not counted.
_localize_exclude: check 4 skips these paths: the term table lists mainland terms on purpose.
_privacy_skip_files: check 5 skips these paths: this file names the institutions it searches for.

privacy_patterns.name: institution: NTUB
privacy_patterns.regex: 北商|臺北商業大學|台北商業大學|(?i:National Taipei University of Business)|(?i:(?<![A-Za-z0-9])NTUB(?![A-Za-z0-9]))

privacy_patterns.name: institution: NTHU
privacy_patterns.regex: (?<![釐澄廓])清大|清華大學|(?i:National Tsing Hua University)|(?i:(?<![A-Za-z0-9])NTHU(?![A-Za-z0-9]))

privacy_patterns.name: department / association
privacy_patterns.regex: 創意科技產品設計|台灣科技藝術教育協會|臺灣科技藝術教育協會

_privacy_patterns: check 5 scans every tracked (and untracked, non-ignored) text file. 清大 excludes 釐清大/澄清大/廓清大, which are ordinary words. Latin acronyms use ASCII-only boundaries because \b treats Han characters as word characters.
_privacy_allow_everywhere: removed from every line before matching: RFC 2606 placeholder addresses and the git SSH host.
_privacy_exempt: in privacy_exempt_files only, these author-attribution and repository/project-page strings are removed before matching; anything else in those files is still reported.
